title: Sephral’s Saved Encounters
description: Save the monsters on the map as an encounter and place the whole group again with one click: counts like 1d4+1 goblins, compendium monsters, a pin on the map, place and start the fight, and a reset to run it once more.

recommends.reason: Rolls the loot of an encounter into a shared loot table where your players claim items with need, want or pass.
